token_heuristic.label: Token heuristic
token_heuristic.detail: Matched a token pattern (length/charset/structure) during the operation.

pii_heuristic.label: PII heuristic
pii_heuristic.detail: Matched a PII pattern during the operation.

secret_regex.label: Secret pattern
secret_regex.detail: Matched a secret regex during the operation.

sink_policy_match.label: Sink policy match
sink_policy_match.short: Operation matches a sensitive sink policy
sink_policy_match.detail: Operation type is flagged by sink policy.

flow_match.label: Taint flow match
flow_match.detail: Untrusted input propagated to a sink.

cross_origin_send.label: Cross-origin send
cross_origin_send.detail: Destination origin differs from the page origin.

unexpected_header.label: Unexpected header
unexpected_header.short: Sensitive data placed in an unusual header
unexpected_header.detail: Header name does not match expected auth headers.

auth_header_same_origin.label: Auth header (same-origin)
auth_header_same_origin.short: Token sent in expected auth header to same-origin
auth_header_same_origin.detail: Typical auth header usage; recorded as an observation.

forbidden_header_attempt_cookie.label: Cookie header attempt
forbidden_header_attempt_cookie.short: Attempted to set forbidden Cookie header
forbidden_header_attempt_cookie.detail: Setting Cookie header manually is unusual in browsers.

storage_persist.label: Sensitive storage
storage_persist.detail: Token-like value stored in local/session storage.

auth_header_same_origin_risky.label: Auth header risky (same-origin)
auth_header_same_origin_risky.short: Auth header used in suspicious same-origin context
auth_header_same_origin_risky.detail: Authorization-like headers were used on same-origin endpoints that look non-API or unusually frequent.

websocket_same_host.label: WebSocket same-host observation
websocket_same_host.short: WebSocket payload sent to same host
websocket_same_host.detail: WebSocket destination matched current host; recorded as observation context.

same_host_exfil_observation.label: Same-host exfil observation
same_host_exfil_observation.short: Potential exfil sink pointed to same host
same_host_exfil_observation.detail: Exfiltration sink used same-host destination; signal was downgraded to observation.

same_origin.label: Same-origin
same_origin.detail: Destination origin matches the page origin.

first_party.label: First-party
first_party.detail: Destination matches an allowlisted first-party origin.

third_party.label: Third-party
third_party.detail: Destination origin differs from the page origin.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.detail: Destination origin could not be determined.

observation.label: Observation
observation.detail: Sensitive data was observed during an operation.

hybrid.label: Observed → Used
hybrid.detail: Observed sensitive data later used in an operation.

policy_violation.label: Policy violation
policy_violation.detail: Operation violated a hard policy regardless of direct taint flow evidence.
